questions.question_text:
What region is represented by the shaded section of the Venn diagram?
Both circles $A$ and $B$, including their overlap, are shaded.

options.why: The intersection would shade only the overlapping lens.
This would also include the outside of B, which is not shaded.

questions.solution_text: The shaded region contains every point in A or in B, including the overlap. This is the union $A\cup B$.
